simple.meaning: גִּדֵּל (Giddêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Giddel , the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גִּדֵּל (H1435) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:47, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּדֵּל (H1435) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גִּדֵּל (H1435) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גִּדֵּל (Giddêl) / H1435 is traced through Ezra 2:47, Ezra 2:56, Nehemiah 7:49, Nehemiah 7:58 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Giddel , the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'
definitions.full: H1435. Giddel גִּדֵּל proper name, masculine ( very great ) — 1 head of one of the families of Nethinim Ezra 2:47 ; Neh 7:49 . 2 head of one of the families of Solomon's servants Ezra 2:56 ; Neh 7:58 .
